entities.name: Mardun
entities.description: A strategically important river flowing from Ronom Lake and the Sardian Mountains, bordering the Great Desert and Fallaji Empire and the kingdoms of Yotia, Argive and Korlis, emptying into the Shielded Sea past Kroog.

entities.name: Sea of Laments
entities.description: The sea that swallowed the river after the Ice Age and the Thaw.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: A city just before which the river emptied into the Shielded Sea.

events.summary: After the later Ice Age and the Thaw, the Mardun is inundated and swallowed by the Sea of Laments.
events.quote: the river was inundated and swallowed by the Sea of Laments
